title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode9 Unwanted Words

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's great that I've been getting more work, but I haven't done any shows lately. I haven't even been able to do any fan meet and greets.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, it's the manager. I need to ask about my schedule.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Oh, right. Well, you've been doing so well that we'd like to start pushing you more as variety show talent.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
To be honest, you just don't stand out enough as an idol.
We've decided to phase you out of that line of work.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hold on a minute!
You've decided to do what?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I fought back, but the agency wanted to go with what they thought would be most popular. They were convinced that was my only option if I wanted to survive in the industry.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ultimately, I decided to move to another agency. The new place was happy to tell me what I wanted to hear at first, but it wasn't long before they went back on their word.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In the end, nobody in the industry thought of me as an idol anymore.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even the fans who used to come and watch me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's not true. You're a wonderful idol, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You give people hope, and are the most—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Just stop, Shizuku. I get it.
I'm not blind, you know. I...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What do you know, Shizuku?!
You've got both looks and talent!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How could you possibly understand someone without your looks, who can't even get others to acknowledge them no matter how hard they try?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Everyone praises you as an idol and you barely have to do anything!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Found you! You're Shizuku Hinomori, the one who won the Grand Prix at the last audition, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm Airi Momoi! I'll be your rival from now on, so don't forget it! And you'd better not let your guard down, or...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, why do you look like you're about to start crying?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, well...everything is just so overwhelming...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My friends sent in an application for me without me knowing, and I ended up getting called for an audition.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then I ended up winning the Grand Prix. Now, everyone is expecting so much from me, but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Everyone here has so much more experience singing and dancing than I do.
I don't want to be a burden on the others.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh... When I heard we had a newcomer with a pretty face, I was expecting someone with more of an attitude.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Pull yourself together! Now that you're an idol, you can't afford to be timid!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Remember, an idol is someone who gives
hope to their fans.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. By giving everything we've got to our role, we're able to pass on those feelings of working hard for tomorrow to our fans.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's why it's important for idols to have heart. It's not about looks or talent. It's about having a positive spirit.
One that gives hope to everyone around them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No matter how uncertain or tough things get, we keep looking forward.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here's a towel. Now dry those tears, already. A pretty face like yours should have a smile on it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're in this idol thing together now. But don't think I'm gonna let you beat me, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's because of what Airi told me back then that I've been able to come this far.)

rows.Speaker: Member A
rows.Line: Shizuku got another solo photo shoot for a magazine cover. This is clearly favoritism.

rows.Speaker: Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess a pretty face is all they care about. We're clearly better at singing and dancing than she is.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Darn, I just can't get this move right. Huh? When did it get so late?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Looks like nobody could make it today. None of them have even checked their messages, either.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka! You came! I'm so glad!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Neither Momoi or Hinomori showed up today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. That might actually be a good thing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wanted to talk to you, Minori. I think I'm going to find somewhere else to read starting tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's actually pretty difficult to focus when you're dancing nearby.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Oh, I guess it would be. You did say you were looking for somewhere quiet, after all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I should be thanking you for coming this long.
You've been watching over me all this time, haven't you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've been able to work even harder knowing that you were here with me. Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Feel free to message me whenever you like.
I'd be happy to walk home with you some time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm going to give this audition everything I've got! I'm definitely going to become an idol just like you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The kind of idol who is able to give everyone around them hope for a better tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Being an idol isn't as wonderful as you think...
